journey.finding: Unsaved selection and note survive Home-return; explicit Save survives reload; export text matches preview; confirmed deletion is absent after reload.

journey.finding: Selectable support prompts and both optional cards have previews, edit paths, explicit save and reload restoration; exports preserve selected content and exclude hidden dates and the other card's data.
journey.barrier: Saved list identifies card type but not personal contents; delete Escape behavior differs between card and sheet confirmation.

journey.finding: Text/display controls include 100–200% in-app text, contrast, dark theme, roomier spacing and reduced motion; keyboard reaches all menu destinations at tested layouts.

preferences: One-section reading with an explicit section count fits T2, provided return restores the last section.
Clear Save, Export and Delete labels, selected counts, previews and unsaved status reduce memory load.
The long appointment page and controls far below the prompts create extra scanning and scrolling.
nextImprovement: Restore the last appointment section after leaving and returning, with a clear return cue.
clinicalApproval: Not assessed; captures show review-pending draft content and do not establish clinical accuracy or suitability.
